title: calendula sinuata var. aurantiaca
intro: Calendula sinuata var. aurantiaca, commonly known as the Orange Marsh Marigold, is a variety of the calendula plant that is native to Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and treating skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of Calendula sinuata var. aurantiaca include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which work together to provide the plant's therapeutic benefits.
